sloka: राक्षसान् पंच साहस्रान् समरेषु अनिवर्तिनः ।ते शूलैः पट्टिशैः कदगैः शिला वरषैः द्रुमैः ॥३-२६-२॥
transliteration: rākṣasān paṁca sāhasrān samareṣu anivartinaḥ ।te śūlaiḥ paṭṭiśaiḥ kadagaiḥ śilā varaṣaiḥ drumaiḥ ॥3-26-2॥

translations.english: The demons continuously hurled at him (Rama) spears and swords and rained stones, trees and arrows from all sides
translations.hindi: से कहा कि श्रीरामचन्द्र के सासने रथ ले चलो
